The schedule from my earlier answer still holds. I re-checked all 17 constraints against it and every one passes.

The team note is wrong. Dev only needs to be three or more slots from Ivo and before Cara. With Dev in slot 1 and Ivo in slot 6, Cara can be in slot 2. Nothing forces her into slot 4, and Ann in slot 4 is exactly one person (Hana) away from Cara.

I did not test other values of Cara's slot, so I haven't shown this is the only valid schedule.

SCHEDULE: {"1":"Dev","2":"Cara","3":"Hana","4":"Ann","5":"Ben","6":"Ivo","7":"Finn","8":"Gus","9":"Elif"}
CONFIDENCE: 99
